annotation.title_clean: Plan de Acción Estrategia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial Costa Rica 2024–2027 (Versión Agosto 2025)
annotation.title_en: Action Plan of the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy, Costa Rica 2024–2027 (August 2025 Version)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación, Tecnología y Telecomunicaciones (MICITT), Costa Rica
annotation.summary_en: August 2025 action plan implementing Costa Rica's National AI Strategy 2024–2027, organised in axes with indicators, targets and responsible bodies. Covers ethical and regulatory frameworks, an AI regulatory sandbox, data protection guidance, government AI use (chatbots), and international leadership. No robotics or physical AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Design and implement an AI regulatory sandbox management model (MICITT-DIDI)
Develop ethical and normative frameworks, including for clinical diagnosis AI (MINSA)
Create a mechanism to measure compliance with ethical and technical norms by AI developers and deployers
Issue data protection good-practice guide for AI projects (PRODHAB)
Institutional AI policies and international governance engagement, including trade agreements (COMEX)
